content: The kind and gracious Lord, the foundation of all excellence,Correctly relying upon him is the very root of the path;Seeing this clearly, may I, with many efforts,Be blessed to rely upon him with great devotion.This excellent foundation of leisure, found but once,Is extremely difficult to obtain and of great significance;May the resolve to take its essence throughout the day and nightArise without interruption—bless me thus.Body and life are as unstable as bubbles on water,Remembering that death destroys them swiftly,And how, after death, just like a body and its shadow,The results of white and black karma follow behind;Having found firm certainty in this, may the multitude of faults—Even the most subtle—be abandoned,And in accomplishing the entire gathering of virtues,Please bless me to always remain conscientious.Through enjoyment one is never satisfied; it is the door to all suffering,The excellences of cyclic existence are unreliable;Having recognized these defects, may a great yearningFor the bliss of liberation arise—bless me thus.Led by that pure intention,With mindfulness, alertness, and great conscientiousness,May I make the Pratimoksha—the root of the teaching—My core practice; please bless me thus.Just as I myself have fallen into the ocean of cyclic existence,So too have all mother sentient beings;Seeing this, bless me to take up the burden of liberating themAnd to master the supreme bodhicitta.Even if the altruistic intention is generated, without trainingIn the three types of ethical discipline, awakening will not be attained;Seeing this clearly, please bless me to train with intense diligenceIn the vows of the victors' heirs.By quieting distractions toward mistaken objects,And by investigating the genuine reality in a correct manner,May the path combining shamatha and vipashyanaSwiftly arise within my mind-stream; please bless me thus.Once I have become a suitable vessel through training in the common path,May I easily enter the Vajrayana, the supreme of all vehicles,Upon that sublime path of entry for fortunate beings;Please bless me to enter with ease.At that time, the basis for accomplishing the two siddhisIs said to be the pure commitments and vows;Having gained unfeigned certainty in this,Please bless me to guard them even at the cost of my life.Then, having realized exactly the essential pointsOf the two stages, the heart of the tantra classes,Through diligent practice, without wavering from the yoga of the four sessions,Please bless me to practice according to the words of the holy ones.Thus, may the spiritual mentors who show the excellent path,And the companions who practice accordingly, have long lives;And may the assembly of outer and inner obstaclesBe thoroughly pacified—please grant your blessings!In all my births, may I never be separated from the authentic Guru,May I enjoy the splendor of the inseparable Dharma,Having fully perfected the qualities of the stages and paths,May I swiftly attain the state of Vajradhara.
